🆘 If You're in Crisis

If you're having thoughts of self-harm or are in immediate danger, please reach out for professional help right away.

Immediate Help

National Crisis Hotline: 988 (US)

Crisis Text Line: Text HOME to 741741

International Association for Suicide Prevention: https://www.iasp.info/resources/Crisis_Centres/

If you're in immediate danger, call emergency services (911 in US) or go to your nearest emergency room.

💡 What to Do Right Now

Step 1: Reach Out

Call a crisis line, text a trusted person, or go to an emergency room. You don't have to be alone.

Step 2: Ground Yourself

Try the 5-4-3-2-1 grounding technique to bring yourself to the present moment. Focus on what you can see, touch, hear, smell, and taste around you.

Step 3: Move Your Body

Go for a walk, splash cold water on your face, or do some stretches. Physical movement can help interrupt the crisis response.

Step 4: Practice Safety

Remove means of harm from your immediate area. Ask a trusted person to stay with you or check in frequently.

💚 Important Reminders

Your Life Has Value

Even when things feel hopeless, circumstances can change. Many people who have felt suicidal have gone on to find meaning, purpose, and joy in their lives.

You Are Not Weak

Having a mental health crisis doesn't make you weak. It makes you human. Seeking help is one of the bravest things you can do.

This Is Temporary

The crisis you're experiencing right now will pass. Your feelings are valid, but they are not permanent. There is help available, and recovery is possible.

🤝 After the Crisis

Once you've gotten through the acute crisis, consider:

  • Scheduling a therapy appointment
  • Connecting with a support group in our SafeSpace community
  • Creating a safety plan with a mental health professional
  • Building a support network of trusted people
  • Taking care of your physical health (sleep, nutrition, movement)

You Matter

Your story isn't over. The world needs you in it. Please reach out today. Help is available, and recovery is possible. You don't have to do this alone.
